subject: Commit phasing & memory tiers — Dedicated capacity proposal
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lu <jason@hearthanalytics.com>, procurement@hearthanalytics.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Commit phasing & memory tiers — Dedicated capacity proposal

Jason / procurement team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is an updated Dedicated capacity proposal tuned for Hearth Analytics' mix (real-time inference + embeddings). High-level summary up front:

- Proposal: two primary reserved pools (inference pool + embedding pool) with shared burst A100 pool for occasional heavy batching.
- Phasing: 50% year 1, 30% year 2, 20% year 3 (we can front-load capacity if needed).
- GPU mix recommendation: H100 (8x) for low-latency, high-throughput inference models; L40S (6x) for embedding/sem-search; A100s (2x) available as burst for batch jobs.
- Pricing: tiered commit discounts in attached PDF; 12/24/36 month tiers with incremental discount steps (10% / 18% / 22%).
- Payment terms: standard is net-30; we can evaluate deferred net-60 on a concession basis (see notes).

Open questions for you so we can finalize the draft:
1) Do you want a hard throughput SLA (tokens/sec) per pool or an availability SLA + best-effort throughput?
2) Is Hearth comfortable with the proposed phasing schedule or prefer a more gradual ramp?
3) Any procurement constraints on payment/PO cadence (we flagged net-60 above)?

I've included a compact pricing matrix (CSV) that maps perf/$ and memory tradeoffs across A100/H100/L40S by typical workloads. If you want, we can convert that into a two-pool SKUs + commit line item table for legal.

Next step: if the approach looks good I can circulate a redlineable MAA and a clean quote for procurement.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_v3.pdf, MAA-draft-terms.docx

From: Jason Lu <jason@hearthanalytics.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@hearthanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commit phasing & memory tiers — Dedicated capacity proposal

Thanks, Priya —

High level this looks promising. A few follow-ups before we take this to legal:

- Can you give ballpark perf/$ (inference throughput per GPU-hour) for the three classes (H100/A100/L40S) using our baseline model mix? We need numbers we can feed into our cost model.
- For the phasing, can you do an 8-week ramp (i.e., first tranche ready at 8 weeks) instead of the 12-week default? That affects our cloud migration timing.
- Procurement: Hearth prefers net-60 when possible but we can do milestone-based payments. Any commercial concession if we choose net-60?
- Also, how do you price memory tiers for L40S (we may have some 80GB model variants). Is there a sizable premium for 80GB vs 48GB?

If helpful I can share our expected token/sec profile (very spiky: lots of short requests + nightly batch embeddings).

—Jason
Jason Lu, Head of ML Infrastructure
Hearth Analytics

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lu <jason@hearthanalytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, procurement@hearthanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 17:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commit phasing & memory tiers — Dedicated capacity proposal

Jason —

Appreciate the questions; below are concrete answers and a few offerable concessions. I pasted the short perf/$ bullets here — happy to walk through in a quick call.

Perf/$ (observed median for workloads like yours):
- H100 (inference-optimized): ~1.9x perf per $ vs A100 on low-latency transformer decoders for short sequence gen (95%ile latency advantages). Ideal for your real-time scoring.
- L40S (embedding-optimized): best cost for dense vector workloads; roughly 2.5x tokens-per-dollar for batched embeddings vs H100 if you can batch to >=128. Memory tier premium: 80GB L40S ~ +18% over 48GB pricing; we can make the first 2 L40S 80GB units non-premium as part of the 24m commit.
- A100 (balanced/burst): good for batch-heavy jobs and for burst capacity; perf/$ sits between H100 and L40S for your mix.

Phasing & delivery: we can commit to an 8-week first tranche for up to 60% of the Year-1 pool (requires early payment on that tranche). Remaining pools on 12/24 week cadence.

Payment terms concession: we can offer net-60, but the committed discount will be reduced by 5 percentage points from the base discount (e.g., 18% -> 13% for a 24m commit if you choose net-60). Alternatively, milestone payments keyed to tranche delivery keep full discount.

SLA: we can offer 99.95% regional uptime with a tokens/sec best-effort throughput guarantee and a defined escalation path; firm per-token throughput SLOs are available as an add-on (extra fee).

Concession (time-limited): sign within 14 days of this email and we will extend an additional 2% price concession on top of quoted discount (applies to the Year-1 tranches only).

I'll convert these bullets into a line-item quote if you confirm: (a) phasing schedule, (b) payment preference (net-30 / net-60 / milestone), (c) preferred GPU mix.

Best,
Priya

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Hearth Analytics follow-ups — need numbers and approval

Rishi / Karthik —

Forwarding Hearth's questions and my reply. Key asks:
- Confirm the perf/$ ratios above and provide a quick table we can paste into the quote (tokens/sec per GPU-hour, mem tier premiums).
- Approve the net-60 concession (reduce committed discount by 5pp) and the signing 2% early-bird concession.
- Confirm we can commit to an 8-week first tranche ready for up to 60% of Y1 pool.

Attached: pricing-matrix.csv (performance numbers, rough $/GPU-month placeholders). Can you review and reply today so I can get a final quote over to them?

Thanks,
Priya

Attachment: pricing-matrix.csv

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Hearth Analytics follow-ups — need numbers and approval

Priya / Karthik —

Reviewed. Agreed to the approach with the following commercial tweaks (approved):

- Perf/$ table (final values to paste into quote):
  * H100: 1,125 median tokens/sec per GPU-hour (real-time gen profile), baseline list $2,900/GPU-month (reserved eq).
  * A100: 620 median tokens/sec per GPU-hour, baseline list $1,900/GPU-month.
  * L40S 48GB: 1,650 tokens/sec per GPU-hour for batched embeddings, baseline list $1,250/GPU-month.
  * L40S 80GB premium: +18% on the L40S list price.

- Discounts (base): 12m = 10%, 24m = 18%, 36m = 22%. If customer selects net-60, reduce the discount by 5pp as Priya suggested.

- Phasing: 8-week delivery for first tranche is feasible if we prioritize procurement and allocation; commit to 60% of Year-1 capacity at 8 weeks, remainder within 12 weeks. Add a clause for "delivery subject to available capacity" in the MAA.

- SLA: approve 99.95% regional uptime; tokens/sec SLO available as paid add-on.

- Commercial concession: approved 2% early-signing credit on Year-1 tranches (time-limited).

Please proceed to issue a redlined quote and an MAA reflecting the payment tradeoffs and the L40S memory premium language. I will loop in finance if they push on net-60.

Rishi
VP, Commercial
redwood@redwood.com
